mcq.q: Truth table mein p ∧ q kitni rows mein TRUE hai (4 rows mein se)?
mcq.explanation: Sirf p = 1 aur q = 1 wali row mein AND true hai.

mcq.q: p = 0 aur q = 1 par p ∨ q ka value kya hai?
mcq.explanation: OR tab true hota hai jab koi ek input true ho.

mcq.q: p = 1 aur q = 0 par p → q ka value kya hai?
mcq.explanation: Conditional false tab hota hai jab p true aur q false ho.

mcq.q: p = 0 aur q = 0 par p ↔ q ka value kya hai?
mcq.explanation: Dono same hain (dono false), isliye biconditional true.

mcq.q: p = 1, q = 0, r = 0 par (p → q) → r ka value kya hai?
mcq.explanation: p → q = 0. Phir 0 → r = 1 (false hypothesis se conditional true).

mcq.q: Slide example mein A ↔ B ka result kya hai (A: p → q, B: ~q → ~p)?
mcq.explanation: Sab rows mein A ↔ B true hai, isliye ye tautology hai.

mcq.q: Distributive table mein p = 1, q = 0, r = 1 par LHS p ∧ (q ∨ r) kya hai?
Slide Example 8 ka statement ~(p ∨ q) → (~q ∨ r) kis type ka hai?
mcq.explanation: Sab 8 rows true hain, isliye tautology hai.
Ye declarative hai aur true hai. Baaki commands, open sentence ya question hain.

mcq.q: p = 1, q = 1 par p ↔ q ka value?
mcq.explanation: Dono true hain, isliye biconditional true.

mcq.q: p = 0, q = 0 par p → q ka value?
mcq.explanation: Conditional false sirf p = T, q = F par hota hai.

mcq.q: p → q ka inverse kaunsa hai?
mcq.explanation: Inverse: dono ko negate karo, swap nahi karo: ~p → ~q.

mcq.q: Conditional aur uska ____ hamesha equivalent hote hain.
Precedence mein ∧ aur ∨ mein kaun pehle?
mcq.explanation: AND (∧) ka precedence OR (∨) se zyada hai.
q ∨ ~q = T, isliye p ∧ T = p. Ye na tautology hai na contradiction.
p ∨ ~p hamesha true hai, isliye tautology.

mcq.q: 2 variables wale truth table mein kitni rows hoti hain?

mcq.explanation: AND commutative hai: p ∧ q ≡ q ∧ p.

short.q: p = 1 aur q = 0 ke liye p → q ka value likho aur reason do.
short.answer: 0 (false). Conditional sirf tab false hota hai jab p true aur q false ho.

short.q: Distributive law wali truth table se LHS aur RHS compare karke conclusion likho.
short.answer: Dono sides ki final columns sab 8 rows mein same hain, isliye p ∧ (q ∨ r) ≡ (p ∧ q) ∨ (p ∧ r).

short.q: Example 2: (~p ∧ ~q) → (p ∨ q) ka truth table banao (r ignore karo; rows pq = 00, 01, 10, 11). Final column likho.
short.answer: Final column: 0 1 1 1. Yani sirf pq=00 par false, baaki true.

short.q: Example 3: (i) p ∨ q ∨ r aur (ii) p ∧ q ∧ r ke truth table ki final columns likho (8 rows, pqr = 000 se 111).
Example 5: (~p → q) → ~r ka truth table banao (pqr = 000 se 111). Final column aur kitni rows true hain?
short.answer: Final column: 1 1 1 0 1 0 1 0. 5 rows true; na tautology na contradiction.

short.q: Example 6: (~p ∧ q) → r ka truth table banao. Final column aur kitni rows true hain?
Example 7: ~[(p ∨ ~q) ∧ ~r] ka truth table banao. Final column likho.
Example 8: ~(p ∨ q) → (~q ∨ r) tautology hai ya nahi? Truth table se justify karo.
short.answer: Haan, tautology hai. Sab 8 rows mein final column 1 hai (1 1 1 1 1 1 1 1), isliye ye tautology hai.

short.q: Example 9: (~p ∧ q) ∨ (~r ∧ q) ka truth table banao. Final column likho.
Distributive law p ∧ (q ∨ r) ≡ (p ∧ q) ∨ (p ∧ r) truth table se verify karo.
short.answer: Haan, dono sides ki final columns sab 8 rows mein same hain, isliye law verify hota hai.

short.q: De Morgan ~(p ∧ q) ≡ ~p ∨ ~q aur associative p ∨ (q ∨ r) ≡ (p ∨ q) ∨ r verify karo.
short.answer: ~(p ∧ q) ≡ ~p ∨ ~q: true (sab rows same). p ∨ (q ∨ r) ≡ (p ∨ q) ∨ r: true (sab rows same).
Iska truth value x ki value par depend karta hai (x = 7 true, x = 2 false), isliye ye fixed true/false nahi hai.

short.q: p = 1, q = 0 ke liye ~p, p ∧ q, p ∨ q, p → q, p ↔ q ke values likho.
'If a number is divisible by 4, then it is even' ka converse, inverse aur contrapositive likho, aur batao kaunsa true hai.
short.answer: Converse: If even, then divisible by 4 (false, 2). Inverse: If not divisible by 4, then odd (false, 6). Contrapositive: If odd, then not divisible by 4 (true). Original aur contrapositive true hain.

short.q: p ∧ (q ∨ ~q) ko simplify karke batao kaise type ka hai.
short.answer: q ∨ ~q = 1, isliye p ∧ 1 = p. Ye contingency hai (na tautology, na contradiction).

short.q: A ⇒ B aur A ⇔ B mein difference likho.
short.answer: A ⇒ B: A → B tautology hai. A ⇔ B: A ↔ B tautology hai, yaani dono same truth table ke hain.

short.q: p ↔ q ka truth table likho (4 rows).
